from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, json, time
W=Path.cwd(); D=W/'temp/eval-prep11'
A=W/'temp/GBS-ROOT-RPI5-SPIKE/local/BUILD-ROOTS/scratch.aarch64.0/emul'
R=W/'temp/GBS-ROOT-LLVM-X86/local/BUILD-ROOTS/scratch.x86_64.0'
def tool(root,name):
 return ['nice','-n','19','ionice','-c3',str(root/'lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2'),'--library-path',str(root/'lib64')+':'+str(root/'usr/lib64'),str(root/'usr/bin'/name)]
def run(label,cmd):
 p=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=D,capture_output=True,text=True)
 v=dict(command=cmd,cwd=str(D),exit=p.returncode,stdout=p.stdout,stderr=p.stderr)
 (D/(label+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
 print(label,p.returncode,p.stderr[:300]); return v
(D/'reference.c').write_text('__attribute__((noinline)) int reference(int x) {\n  if (x > 7) return x * 3;\n  return x + 11;\n}\n')
clang=tool(A,'clang'); pd=tool(R,'llvm-profdata')
run('clang-version',clang+['--version'])
for kind,flag in [('frontend','-fprofile-instr-generate'),('ir','-fprofile-generate')]:
 args=['--target=aarch64-tizen-linux-gnu','-ffreestanding','-O2','-g','-fdebug-info-for-profiling','-funique-internal-linkage-names','-mllvm','-disable-preinline',flag,'-S','-emit-llvm','reference.c','-o',kind+'.ll']
 run(kind+'-driver',clang+args+['-###'])
 run(kind+'-generate',clang+args)
import re
summary={}
for kind in ['frontend','ir']:
 ll=(D/(kind+'.ll')).read_text()
 line=next(s for s in ll.splitlines() if s.startswith('@__profd_reference ='))
 h=int(re.search(r'\} \{ i64 -?\d+, i64 (-?\d+),',line)[1]) % (1<<64)
 (D/(kind+'.proftext')).write_text((':ir\n' if kind=='ir' else '')+f'reference\n{h}\n2\n100\n30\n\n')
 merge=run(kind+'-merge',pd+['merge','-o',kind+'.profdata',kind+'.proftext'])
 show=run(kind+'-show',pd+['show','--all-functions','--counts',kind+'.profdata'])
 use=run(kind+'-use',clang+['--target=aarch64-tizen-linux-gnu','-ffreestanding','-O2','-g','-fdebug-info-for-profiling','-funique-internal-linkage-names','-mllvm','-disable-preinline','-fprofile-use='+kind+'.profdata','-mllvm','-print-after=pgo-instr-use','-S','-emit-llvm','reference.c','-o',kind+'-use.ll'])
 summary[kind]={'hash':h,'merge_exit':merge['exit'],'use_exit':use['exit'],'pgo_instr_use_dump': 'IR Dump After PGOInstrumentationUse on' in use['stderr'],'stderr_bytes':len(use['stderr'].encode()),'final_IR_has_entry_count':'function_entry_count' in (D/(kind+'-use.ll')).read_text()}
(D/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
